value.text: Red on fd7d3bb: scratch worktree at fd7d3bb plus only the new tests (main-API variants). Failing for the named reasons: 1 ns retry stored at the same whole second; a backing-off body overtaken by its file (JobId(2) claimed); 429 retry_after 30/45 retried at 100 ms; a failing job retried 20 times at 100 ms with no give-up; inbound turn missing while outbound retries; stalled upload starves inbound (Elapsed); 14,400 calls per simulated hour; reused msg_id with other bytes answered 200 with a receipt for the new sha; CLI resolves a symlink to target.html. New surfaces (enqueue_all, MAX_ATTEMPTS, sweep_staged) are compile-red. assets/evidence/red-on-fd7d3bb.md.

Backoff, retry_after, attempt cap, order, green on bafee67: sidecars retry_tests (backoff_doubles_to_a_cap_honours_retry_after_and_ends, a_429_on_a_text_send/upload, a_job_that_keeps_failing_backs_off_then_gives_up, a_retry_after_past_the_ceiling_fails_the_job_now), store queue_retry_order (retry_positive_delay_never_becomes_eligible_early, telegram_rows_on_one_chat_keep_fifo_while_the_head_backs_off, other_kinds_are_not_held_behind_a_backing_off_row), daemon telegram_order (files_wait_behind_a_retrying_body_until_it_gives_up: real SqliteQueue + worker + fake Telegram). crates/sidecars/src/telegram.rs retry_delay/give_up; crates/store/src/queue.rs CLAIM_NEXT_SQL, not_before_after.

Inbound every tick and timeouts, green on bafee67: inbound_is_delivered_while_an_outbound_job_retries (run_once polls inbound whatever outbound did); a_stalled_upload_ends_as_a_retry_and_inbound_keeps_polling drives the SHIPPED start(): two loops, inbound turn delivered while the upload is still in flight, upload ends as a retry at its timeout; production_timeouts_are_sized_for_a_fifty_megabyte_upload (connect 10 s, API 30 s, upload 600 s: 50 MB at 1 Mbit/s = 400 s).

Producer and nits, green on bafee67: S2 shim_http the_producer_queues_the_body_then_each_file_in_order (hermetic, no tmux; X2 dies, see mutants). N1 a_reused_msg_id_with_other_content_is_refused_and_leaves_no_copy + store queue_enqueue_all (Conflict rolls back the batch; identical resend collapses). N2 the_sweep_removes_copies_older_than_the_retention_only + the_shipped_loop_sweeps_expired_staged_copies (7 days, first pass then every 6 h, in process). N3 an_error_mid_batch_queues_nothing_from_that_batch (trigger fault on the 3rd row, 0 live rows). N4 CLI a_symlinked_attachment_keeps_the_typed_name + shim a_symlinked_attachment_is_named_by_the_link_from_the_shim. Token: the_token_never_leaks_on_any_media_failure_path now also checks the Conflict live_payload.

Cost: a_failing_job_costs_a_bounded_number_of_calls_per_hour = 10 calls per simulated hour of 250 ms ticks (5 in minute one), 14,400 on fd7d3bb; the FIFO sub-query SEARCHes index jobs_serial on a 5,000-row ANALYZEd store (EXPLAIN of the production CLAIM_NEXT_SQL); no launch site in telegram*.rs; live BEFORE spawn reading taken read-only. AFTER reading is the prime's post-merge step. assets/evidence/cost.md.

Docs: docs/how/pij-telegram.md section 'Retries, timeouts and inbound (plan 183)' (backoff, retry_after, cap and telegram.outbound-gave-up, order on a chat, timeouts with reasons, inbound loop, cost) plus files bullets for the 7-day retention sweep, one-batch enqueue, msg_id reuse rule and symlink naming.
